info.title: Medicine Passport API
info.description:
Medicine Passport patient/admin API. Generated from the Nest routes plus the Zod DTOs in `packages/validation` (ADR-V2-013); pinned at `apps/api/openapi.json` and diffed in CI.

Conventions (docs_v2/05): `/v1` prefix; RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` errors with a stable `code` and `correlationId`; opaque session cookie or bearer; `x-requested-with: medpass` on cookie-borne writes; `x-profile-id` selects the active profile; `idempotency-key` on retried writes; `x-client` names the calling client; step-up endpoints answer `403 step_up_required` when the session's re-verification is older than 10 minutes; `x-correlation-id` is echoed on every response.

Response bodies marked `x-response-schema-source: hand-written` are provisional descriptions maintained by hand until a Zod response schema exists; request bodies marked `zod` are authoritative.

servers.description: Same origin as the calling app (the PWA calls /v1 on its own origin).

tags.name: ABDM
tags.description: ABHA identity and ABDM PHR flows (docs_v2/05 §10, docs_v2/08 §5). ABHA is never required to use the product. Received bundles only ever become confirmation-queue candidates (docs_v2/08 §7).

tags.name: Admin: ABDM
tags.description: AbdmTransaction explorer (abdm_operations duty): kinds, statuses, gateway ids, error codes and timings — never request or response bodies.

tags.name: Admin: Auth
tags.description: Admin-portal sessions: password + TOTP MFA, separate cookie and privilege model.

tags.name: Admin: FHIR
tags.description: FhirValidationFailure rows (fhir_view duty): structural validator findings by direction, IG version and resource path.

tags.name: Admin: Platform
tags.description: V2 admin platform (docs_v2/14 §3): feature flags (super_admin), break-glass grants and log (audit_search), consent audit (audit_search), document-processing funnel, integrations health and notification failures (operations_view). Ids are opaque; no clinical value is ever returned.

tags.name: Admin: Providers
tags.description: Provider / facility directory (provider_admin duty): global Organization and Practitioner entries, HFR/HPR verification, merges. Patient-entered rows are returned as opaque ids with counts only.

tags.name: Admin: Support
tags.description: Support cases (support_cases duty, docs_v2/14 §5): operational records that point at a profile by opaque id only; notes are PHI-free by policy. Break-glass is a separate, audited grant.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Patient identity: phone OTP sign-in, remembered devices, session refresh, step-up (ADR-V2-012).

tags.name: Caregivers
tags.description: Caregiver invitations, scopes and access logs.

tags.name: Clinical profile
tags.description: Structured clinical profile (docs_v2/05 §2): allergies, conditions, immunizations, procedures, family history, emergency contacts. Clients never send `provenance`.

tags.name: Diagnostics
tags.description: Labs and imaging (docs_v2/05 §6) — the V2 successor to Reports, with units, structured reference ranges and corrections that supersede instead of overwrite. The V1 `reports` endpoints stay live and now dual-write here.

tags.name: FHIR
tags.description: FHIR R4 export of the patient's own record through the versioned ABDM IG layer (docs_v2/08 §2, §8; ADR-V2-001/003). Step-up guarded and audited; mapping gaps are recorded as FhirValidationFailure rows, never blocking.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness/readiness probes, registered outside the /v1 prefix.

tags.name: Health timeline
tags.description: Unified health timeline (docs_v2/05 §3) — distinct from the per-day dose timeline under Scheduling.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: Platform metadata: version, feature flags, the pinned OpenAPI document.

tags.name: Observations
tags.description: Home measurements and vitals (docs_v2/05 §7, ADR-V2-011) — one model for every concept, plus device sync and measurement devices. The V1 glucose / blood-pressure / weight diaries stay live and now dual-write here.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Patient-scoped facilities (docs_v2/05 §2).

tags.name: Profiles
tags.description: Patient profiles (self, dependents) and their clinical profile lists.

tags.name: Proposals
tags.description: The patient's Proposals inbox: everything awaiting acceptance across organizations, and the accept / reject decisions.

tags.name: Provider: Auth
tags.description: Provider-portal sessions (docs_v2/05 §11): phone OTP sign-in for organization staff; a distinct token type from patient and admin sessions.

tags.name: Provider: Organizations
tags.description: The signed-in staff member's organization and its members (owner-only writes). The organization kind decides which proposal kinds it may send.

tags.name: Provider: Patients
tags.description: QR onboarding and the section-scoped, time-boxed ProviderPatientLink; every provider read is audited with the organization id.

tags.name: Provider: Proposals
tags.description: Providers propose, patients accept (ADR-V2-009): reconciliations, prescriptions, encounters, dispenses, diagnostic reports and discharge transitions are stored as proposals and write nothing clinical until accepted.

tags.name: Sharing
tags.description: Visit summaries and time-boxed public share links.

tags.name: Sync
tags.description: Offline mutation replay (docs/15).

tags.name: Terminology
tags.description: Static, PHI-free code tables (LOINC codes, canonical units, plausibility ranges). Public: identical for every caller, and needed before there is a session.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Provider callbacks verified by signature; never carry patient credentials.

get.summary: Readings around a medicine's start date, and at roughly 30 and 90 days after
get.description:
docs_v2/06 P10-2. Three fixed, server-owned windows — baseline (−30…0 days), day 30 (+15…+45) and day 90 (+75…+105) — each returned with its absolute bounds and the descriptive statistics the trend endpoints already produce (count, average, min, max). There is deliberately no difference, percentage, direction, rating or verdict field: two numbers either side of a date are a coincidence in time, and computing anything from them would be a clinical claim this app is not entitled to make (docs_v2/10 §1). `hasEnoughPoints: false` means too few of the patient's own readings, never "no effect". Requires `view_medications` plus `view_tests` (with `analyteKey`) or `view_measurements` (with `concept`).

Patient session (cookie or bearer). Profile access: `view_medications` on `x-profile-id`.
